tagline.en: Prepaid data in 200+ destinations, from $4 for 1GB/3 days
tagline.zh: 200+ 目的地的预付费流量，1GB/3 天 4 美元起

description.en: Airalo is the one most people try first, and it mostly holds up: 200+ destinations, the same buying flow everywhere, and one app that keeps every eSIM you own in a list. Plans come in three shapes, a single country, a region (Asia, Europe, Africa and so on), or Discover+ for near-global use. Japan runs US$4.00 for 1GB/3 days up to US$25.00 for 20GB/30 days, with unlimited tiers from US$11.50/3 days; the USA is close behind at US$4.00 for 1GB/3 days, US$36.50 for 20GB/30 days and US$42.00 for 50GB. Support answers in several languages, around the clock.
description.zh: 多数人第一次买 eSIM 都会先试 Airalo，结果通常也不差：200+ 目的地，到处一样的下单流程，所有 eSIM 集中在一个 App 里。套餐分三种规模，单国、区域（亚洲、欧洲、非洲等）、以及几乎全球通用的 Discover+。日本 1GB/3 天 4.00 美元起，20GB/30 天 25.00 美元，不限量 11.50 美元/3 天起；美国 1GB/3 天 4.00 美元起，20GB/30 天 36.50 美元，50GB 42.00 美元。客服多语言，7×24 在线。

details.en:
Airalo's strength is consistency at scale: 200+ destinations with a uniform buying flow, an app that stores all your eSIMs in one place, and instant top-ups that add data to a running eSIM without reinstalling. Its catalogue splits into three tiers — local plans for a single country, regional plans (Asia, Europe, Africa and more) covering dozens of countries each, and a global plan usable almost everywhere — which makes it easy to pick the right scope. Verified pricing from the official storefront: a Japan eSIM runs US$4.00 for 1 GB / 3 days up to US$25.00 for 20 GB / 30 days, with unlimited options from US$11.50 / 3 days; the USA is similar (1 GB / 3 days from US$4.00, 20 GB / 30 days US$36.50, plus 50 GB and unlimited tiers). Airalo also runs Discover+ global multi-network plans and frequent seasonal discounts in the app.

Support is 24/7 and genuinely multilingual, and the regional packages (e.g. shared data across 10+ Asian countries) remain the reference point that other providers' regional offers are compared against.
details.zh:
Airalo 的强项在于规模化的一致性：200+ 目的地统一购买流程，App 集中管理所有 eSIM，续购即时生效且无需重装。

套餐目录分三层——单国本地包、覆盖数十国的区域包（亚洲、欧洲、非洲等）以及几乎全球通用的全球包——选择范围一目了然。经官方商店核验的价格：日本 eSIM 从 1 GB / 3 天 4.00 美元到 20 GB / 30 天 25.00 美元，另有 11.50 美元/3 天起的不限量档；美国相近（1 GB / 3 天 4.00 美元起，20 GB / 30 天 36.50 美元，另有 50 GB 与不限量档）。App 内还有 Discover+ 全球多网络套餐与季节性折扣。客服 7×24 小时多语言在线；区域包（如 10+ 亚洲国家共享流量）是全行业区域套餐的比价基准。

bestFor.en: A first eSIM purchase, or a trip that crosses several countries. You pay a little more per gigabyte so that nothing goes wrong.
bestFor.zh: 第一次买 eSIM，或者一趟要跨好几个国家。每 GB 贵一点，换来基本不出问题。

en: Top up anytime without changing SIM

plansNote.en: Japan/USA single-country prices verified from airalo.com in September 2026. Regional and Discover+ pricing varies by promotion — check the app for live rates.
plansNote.zh: 日本/美国单国价格于 2026 年 9 月经 airalo.com 核验。区域包与 Discover+ 价格随促销浮动，以 App 内实时价为准。

en: 200+ destinations, with regional and near-global plans in the same account
Top-ups land on the running eSIM, no reinstall
Support is human and multilingual, any hour
The baseline other providers get measured against, which makes judging the rest easier
zh: 200+ 目的地，区域包和准全球包都在同一个账号里
续购直接加到在用的 eSIM 上，不用重装
行业比价基准，拿它衡量别家最省事

en: Rarely the cheapest per gigabyte, discount brands undercut it
Single-network local plans in some countries, so coverage drops indoors
zh: 单价很少是最低，低价品牌常能再压一档
部分单国包只接一家网络，室内信号会掉

country.en: varies (commonly Singapore/France/US, not the destination country)
country.zh: 不定（常见新加坡/法国/美国，与实际目的地无关）

note.en: Academic measurement (arXiv 2408.14923) shows most Airalo eSIMs are roaming-based with IPX hub breakout: public-internet gateways commonly sit at Singapore Singtel (AS45143), France OVH (AS16276) or US Packet Host (AS54825), i.e. datacenter IPs unrelated to the visited country. Airalo itself does not guarantee IP geolocation matches the destination.
note.zh: arXiv 2408.14923 实测：Airalo 多为漫游架构，出口常见新加坡 Singtel(AS45143)、法国 OVH(AS16276)、美国 Packet Host(AS54825)，即机房 IP，与所在地无关；官方也不保证 IP 与目的地一致。
